stories.title: Kate Middleton Wraps Up India Visit In Custom Gaurav Gupta Suit, Meets PM Modi - News18
Kate Middleton concludes India tour with Gaurav Gupta pantsuit
stories.summary: The Princess of Wales concluded her three-day visit to India with a meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Throughout the tour, she showcased a series of sophisticated outfits, with sharply tailored pantsuits becoming a defining feature of her diplomatic wardrobe. The final ensemble was a custom Gaurav Gupta creation.

stories.title: Royal visit highlights India-UK textile partnerships
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales visited the Chanakya School of Craft in Mumbai on November 18. The visit focused on projects connecting India and the UK through fashion and technology, including the New Landscapes India programme, which provides funding and business development support for six bilateral research partnerships.

stories.title: Fashion Designer Siddartha Tytler Brings India's OG Models Back To The Ramp For 25th Anniversary Show - News18
Vogue India hosts Forces of Fashion 2026
Video | Princess Kate's Desi Style Statement: What She Wore On Her India Visit - NDTV
Kate Middleton highlights cultural ties during India tour
stories.summary: The Princess of Wales joined Prince William for a three-day visit to Mumbai, marking their first joint overseas trip in four years. The couple attended engagements focused on environmental innovation, sustainable fashion, and cricket, while highlighting cultural ties between Britain and India during their meeting with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

stories.title: Prince William, Kate Meet Modi, Conclude Three-Day India Visit - IndiaWest
Analysis examines diplomatic messaging in royal wardrobe
stories.summary: Princess Kate’s three-day India wardrobe combined British designers, Indian jewelry, and sustainable materials. Experts suggest the choices served as a form of diplomatic dressing, continuing a mantle established by Queen Elizabeth. The visit was centered around the sixth annual Earthshot Prize gala held in the country.

stories.title: Bottega Veneta releases Venice-inspired photo series
stories.summary: Bottega Veneta has unveiled a Spring 2027 photo series titled Colours of Venice, shot by Chris Rhodes. Under Creative Director Louise Trotter, the imagery pairs saturated hues with historic interiors. The campaign spotlights the brand's Cabat tote and a new 1970s-inspired handbag, the Verde.

stories.title: Gucci to host 2028 Cruise show in Shanghai
stories.summary: Gucci will present its 2028 Cruise Collection in Shanghai on May 17, 2027, to mark the house's 30th anniversary. Creative director Demna Gvasalia will lead the presentation. The brand is currently navigating a slowing market, and the event is intended to provide a necessary boost.

stories.title: Fear of God explores relaxed tailoring in Ten collection
stories.summary: Designer Jerry Lorenzo presented his Ten collection, which explores a mix of relaxed tailoring and athleticwear. Lorenzo stated the designs were influenced by how he dresses daily and how Gen-Zers style their clothes. The collection builds on tropes the designer has been refining for 13 years.

stories.title: Fear of God Fall 2027 collection imagery
Costume design challenges in The Gilded Age
stories.summary: Costume designer Kasia Walicka-Maimone managed the production of period-specific outfits for the third episode of The Gilded Age. The episode required costumes for the main cast, dozens of extras, and new supporting characters for a wedding and a fashionable salon. The director utilized wide shots to capture them.

stories.title: Adriana Lima discusses Victoria's Secret runway return
stories.summary: Adriana Lima walked in this year's Victoria's Secret fashion show and appeared in the brand's holiday campaign. Lima has worked with the company since 1998, a relationship the brand describes as iconic. She recently expressed interest in seeing a future show hosted in Brazil.

stories.title: Gucci updates Horsebit jewellery collection
stories.summary: Gucci has released a new fine jewellery and watch collection featuring its Horsebit motif. First appearing in the 1940s, the equestrian-inspired hardware has been applied to various accessories for decades. The new pieces were captured by photographer Carlijn Jacobs in a series inspired by cinematic narratives.

stories.title: Jennifer Lopez coordinates beauty with monochromatic fashion
stories.summary: Jennifer Lopez wore a monochromatic merlot-toned outfit consisting of a leather trench, silk minidress, lace tights, and patent stilettos. She extended the color scheme to her beauty routine, matching her nails, eyeshadow, and lip liner to the clothing. The look was described as a masterclass in color coordination.

stories.title: Festive gold sales value jumps 15-25 percent despite high prices
stories.summary: Retailers reported a 15-25 percent year-on-year increase in gold sales value during the Dhanteras-Diwali period, according to the World Gold Council. The growth occurred despite elevated prices, with demand bolstered by a decline in rates starting in mid-October. Buying was broad-based across jewellery, bars, and coins.

stories.title: Dhanteras-Diwali 2026: Higher jewellery sales volume drives sharp value growth - The Retail Jeweller India
GIVA secures $100 mn+ funding in a record investment in the new-age jewellery sector - The Retail Jeweller India
Gold companies slide as annual performance hits 13-year low
stories.summary: Shares of Titan, Kalyan Jewellers, and other gold-related firms declined as the Nifty Consumer Durables index fell 3.1 percent. Gold is currently tracking toward its worst annual performance in 13 years. Gold financiers including Muthoot Finance and Manappuram Finance also saw share prices drop during the session.

stories.title: Diamond and gemstone jewellery sales rise amid gold volatility
stories.summary: Festive demand for diamond-studded and coloured gemstone jewellery increased this year, according to IDT Gemological Labs. Retailers reported shortages in lightweight 9-carat and 14-carat categories ahead of Diwali. Despite sharp price swings in gold and silver, consumers continued to spend on alternative jewellery designs throughout the festive season.

stories.title: Roksanda launches debut jewelry collection
stories.summary: Roksanda has released Fossa, a collection of earrings, rings, cuffs, and necklaces made from 14-karat gold-plated brass. The pieces, which feature hammered textures and pops of colour, were designed by Roksanda Ilincic and are manufactured in Italy. The collection is available for purchase on the designer's website.

stories.title: Van Cleef & Arpels celebrates its butterfly motif in Montecito - South China Morning Post
Buccellati defends long production times for luxury jewelry
stories.summary: Lucrezia Buccellati stated that some pieces from the family's Milan house require up to two years to deliver. The designer attributed the wait to the need for skilled artisans, noting that mastery of the house's work requires a decade of training. The brand is currently resisting automation.

stories.title: Silvia Furmanovich discusses materials in fine jewelry
stories.summary: Brazilian designer Silvia Furmanovich is incorporating natural materials such as horsehair, silk, and bamboo into her fine jewellery collections. The designer collaborates with global artisans to transform these elements into handcrafted pieces. The work was recently showcased during an intimate dinner event in Fort Worth.

stories.title: Handbag investment advice for 2026
stories.summary: Buying a luxury handbag now requires weeks or months of consideration, according to recent fashion guidance. Consumers are encouraged to budget for six months or longer when a new model debuts during fashion week. The advice suggests selecting versatile bags suitable for both office use and formal evening events.

stories.title: Rimowa and Rockstar Games release limited edition console case
stories.summary: Rimowa has partnered with Rockstar Games to produce a special edition luggage case designed to house a PlayStation 5 console and controllers. The project celebrates the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI. The bespoke luggage set is strictly limited to an exclusive Friends and Family edition.

stories.title: H. Moser and Cie unveils limited edition tourbillon
stories.summary: H. Moser and Cie has released the Pioneer Tourbillon Arctic Fizz, a 100-piece limited edition watch priced at approximately $65,950. The 40mm titanium timepiece features a frosted blue dial and 120-meter water resistance. The company claims the model is intended for use in the water.

stories.title: Chanel hosts holiday jewelry and watch dinner
stories.summary: Chanel held a holiday dinner at the restaurant Humm in New York to showcase its fine jewellery and watch collections. Guests, including actors and musicians, wore pieces from the brand's Première Galon and Coco Crush lines. The event focused on the company's French fine accessories.

stories.title: Chanel dinner gathers creative guests in New York
stories.summary: Chanel hosted a holiday dinner at the restaurant Humm in New York to promote its fine jewellery and watch collections. The event, themed The Joy of Encounters, brought together a group of actors, musicians, and designers. Guests mingled over cocktails before a candlelit dinner.

stories.title: Chanel hosts fine jewelry dinner for celebrities
stories.summary: Chanel held a dinner event at the restaurant Humm in New York to showcase its fine jewellery and watch collections. The guest list included actors Sarah Pidgeon, Ella Rubin, and Ella Beatty, along with musician Jack Harlow. The evening featured various attendees wearing pieces from the brand.

stories.title: Chanel hosts holiday dinner at Humm
stories.summary: Chanel held an intimate holiday dinner at the restaurant Humm in New York on November 17. The event, themed The Joy of Encounters, was inspired by Gabrielle Chanel's tradition of hosting creative voices. Attendees included actors, musicians, and costume designers, all wearing Chanel jewellery.

stories.title: Chanel hosts jewelry dinner with musical performance
stories.summary: Chanel held a holiday dinner for its fine jewellery and watch collections at the restaurant Humm in New York. The event featured a performance by the musician Girlsweetvoiced. Attendees included Sarah Pidgeon, Ella Rubin, and Devon Lee Carlson, who were among the first guests at the new venue.

stories.title: Refillable perfume jewelry gains popularity
stories.summary: Perfume jewellery, including refillable amulets, rings, and bracelets, is emerging as a beauty accessory trend. Most items in the category are priced under $100. Industry commentators note that the trend draws inspiration from historical fragrance practices, including the use of frankincense and early 20th-century Cartier designs.

stories.title: Madhya Pradesh approves 341 hectare textile park in Dhar
stories.summary: Madhya Pradesh will develop a 341 hectare textile park in Dhar district, with officials projecting 35,000 jobs and Rs 6,150 crore in investment. The state cabinet approved the project alongside other industrial allocations exceeding Rs 2,700 crore. The park aims to attract large-scale manufacturing to the region.

stories.title: Government plans integrated textile census
stories.summary: The government has initiated an Integrated Textile Census to create a comprehensive database across 15 industry segments, including handloom and powerloom. The project aims to unify household and establishment production units under a single digital platform. The previous census only covered the handloom sector.

stories.title: New textile census to cover 15 industry segments
stories.summary: The upcoming textile census will track production, sales, and employment for 15 industry segments using FY26 as the reference period. Officials say the survey will utilize a unified digital platform to record machinery and tools. The previous ministry census was limited to the handloom sector alone.

stories.title: How Africa's Baoule textiles are revolutionizing fashion - NewsBytes
Jewelry making open house in Sun City West
stories.summary: SilverCraft West is hosting an open house on November 21 at the R.H. Johnson Recreation Center. Members will demonstrate jewelry making tools and processes used to transform metal into art. Visitors can observe the studio work and learn about the craft of creating handmade pieces.

stories.title: DIY tutorial suggests turning coins into jewelry
stories.summary: A new tutorial suggests transforming ordinary coins into jewelry as a budget-friendly DIY project. The guide encourages users to repurpose everyday currency into accessories. It is presented as a way to unleash creativity through simple crafting techniques.

stories.title: Video highlights scrap metal jewelry crafting
stories.summary: A creative craft video demonstrates the process of turning scrap metal into jewelry pieces. The project focuses on repurposing raw, discarded materials into accessories. It is intended to inspire jewelry enthusiasts and DIY hobbyists to view scrap as a source for wearable masterpieces.

stories.title: Vegan fashion market sees growth in animal-free materials
stories.summary: The vegan fashion market is growing as brands prioritize animal-free materials like plant-based and recycled alternatives. The industry is shifting away from leather, fur, wool, and silk due to consumer interest in sustainability and ethical production. The market is currently focused on apparel and footwear categories.

stories.title: Haus of Raya promotes sustainable fashion in Detroit
stories.summary: Detroit designer Raya Chodock is building her sustainable fashion label, Haus of Raya, with a focus on local culture and vintage reworks. The brand emphasizes the importance of manufacturing and business development within the city of Detroit.

stories.title: Detroit designer builds brand on local culture
stories.summary: Raya Chodock, founder of Haus of Raya, is developing her sustainable fashion business in Detroit. After spending time in Chicago and New York, Chodock returned to her home state to launch the label. The brand centers on vintage reworks and local identity.

stories.title: Denver sustainable market hosts clothing swap
stories.summary: A sustainable market and clothing swap held at a Denver brewery featured 14 local businesses and nonprofits. The event, timed for America Recycles Day, aimed to provide community-minded shopping alternatives. Organizers reported that the clothing swap diverted hundreds of pounds of textiles from the landfill.

stories.title: Commercial funding lags for textile recycling
stories.summary: Global textile recycling is facing a financial bottleneck as commercial loans remain scarce. According to the Systemic Bankability report, only three of 13 identified recycling methods currently attract commercial funding. Proven technology is struggling to secure the necessary capital for industry-wide scaling.

stories.title: Digital product passports struggle to support circularity
stories.summary: Research by Circular Fashion News found that only 18 percent of digital product passports in the apparel sector support reuse or recycling. Most passports currently prioritize traceability and authentication over circularity. Repair remains the most common function among the 11 percent of passports that offer it.

stories.title: Student initiative provides prom dresses to those in need
stories.summary: University of Northern Iowa student Norah Lipovac founded DressedtoServe, an initiative that collects dress donations for girls who cannot afford formal wear. The project aims to help students attend milestones like prom. Lipovac was inspired by the financial barriers she observed in her own community.

stories.title: AI startup targets textile manufacturing efficiency
stories.summary: Smartex.AI is attempting to modernize textile manufacturing, which CEO Max Easton claims still relies on manual quality checks and 1970s-era supply chains. The company aims to use AI to detect fabric defects, a task currently performed by workers watching cloth rolls for holes and needles.

stories.title: Kering appoints Nike executive as group pricing director
stories.summary: Kering has appointed former Nike director Francisco Ochando as its first group director of pricing. The move follows the company's decision to make pricing central to its turnaround strategy after acknowledging that previous price increases negatively impacted sales volumes. The group is now adjusting its approach.

stories.title: Kering Hires Group Pricing Director: Why It Matters
stories.summary: What happened Kering has appointed Francisco Ochando to the newly created role of group pricing director, the company confirmed on Wednesday. Ochando, who took up the position on November 16, reports to Marilyne Trebus, Kering’s chief product officer, who in turn reports to Carlo Mocci, the group’s chief client officer.

stories.title: LVMH reports 1 per cent growth as China demand slows
stories.summary: LVMH reported third-quarter revenue of 18.504 billion euros, an organic increase of 1 per cent. Growth in the US and Japan helped offset weaker demand in China, which weighed on the company's Fashion and Leather Goods division. Luxury remains seasonal.

stories.title: "Today, there’s no money left in fashion photography," says Ellen von Unwerth - FashionNetwork - The World's Fashion Bus
Fashion executives discuss retail delivery speeds
stories.summary: Senior executives from brands including Ralph Lauren and Victoria Beckham met in New York to discuss the demand for rapid delivery. The event was hosted in partnership with InstaMall, a localized fulfillment company. The industry is currently debating whether it needs to catch up with consumer expectations.

stories.title: Record prices for rare diamonds at auction
stories.summary: Rare diamonds continue to reach high prices at auction, driven by their size, color, and clarity. These geological marvels are formed deep within the Earth over billions of years. Competition for the most exceptional stones remains fierce, with pink and blue diamonds frequently dominating the record books.

General Pants enters voluntary administration
stories.summary: General Pants has entered voluntary administration, putting 500 jobs and 35 stores at risk. The retailer is the fourth major trans-Tasman failure in ten weeks. As rent and inventory costs persist, the company joins a growing list of fashion retailers struggling to maintain a clear reason to exist.

stories.title: General Pants collapse fuels retail crisis fears
stories.summary: The collapse of a major Australian youth fashion chain ahead of the biggest sales period of the year is further bad news for the retail sector after a string of recent failures. Clothing chain General Pants Co has gone into voluntary administration, leaving 500 workers and 35 stores at risk

stories.title: Beloved fashion retailer General Pants collapses into administration
stories.summary: Fashion retailer General Pants has collapsed into voluntary administration, with nearly 500 jobs and 35 stores now in jeopardy. It comes only a week after the collapse of department store giant David Jones, as well as a raft of other retailers this year. General Pants had earlier shrunk its physical

stories.title: General Pants collapses after years of trouble
stories.summary: Youth fashion retailer General Pants has been handed over to administrators after years of struggling sales and unprofitability, putting another 500 retail jobs on the line as David Jones prepares to announce 1500 redundancies. General Pants’ network of 35 stores remains open for trading despite company directors having handed over

stories.summary: General Pants, the youth fashion chain backed by the billionaire Smorgon family, has collapsed and left hundreds of jobs in limbo. stories.title: Retail collapses continue as General Pants Co calls in administrators
stories.summary: Australian retailer General Pants Co is the latest in a growing list of fashion brands to collapse into voluntary administration, putting 500 jobs on the line. The news comes just weeks after heritage department store David Jones was put into administration and days after it confirmed at least 1500 jobs

LVMH Prize 2027 opens applications for its 14th edition
stories.summary: LVMH has opened applications for its 14th annual prize, inviting designers aged 18 to 40 to compete for mentorship and financial support. Applicants must have produced at least two collections to be considered. The semi-final round is scheduled for early March 2027. The search for the next big thing continues.

stories.title: CFDA selects three finalists for $100,000 empowered vision award - FashionNetwork - The World's Fashion Business News
Taus named to Copenhagen Fashion Week NewTalent roster
stories.summary: Copenhagen Fashion Week has added the brand Taus to its NewTalent program for the fall 2027 season. Founded in 2024, the label joins returning participants Studio Constance and Stem on the official show schedule. Chief executive officer Cecilie Thorsmark cited the founders for their real talent and ambition.

stories.title: Gucci seeks junior designer for fur and leather
stories.summary: Gucci is hiring a junior designer for its fur and leather division in Milan. Reporting to the head of design, the role requires the candidate to work in line with the creative vision of artistic director Demna. The luxury house continues to focus on Italian craftsmanship and innovation.

stories.title: Harper College student receives national fashion scholarship
stories.summary: Vanessa Carrasco, a student at Harper College, has received a scholarship from the Fashion Scholarship Fund. Carrasco began teaching herself to sew during the pandemic after struggling to find stylish clothing in plus sizes. She now aims to design garments that provide a better fit for everyone.

stories.title: Goodwill South Texas announces October 2027 fashion fundraiser
stories.summary: Goodwill South Texas will host its Work the Runway fundraiser in October 2027. The event challenges student designers to create looks using only thrifted items under the theme of identity. Proceeds from the show support local job training, scholarships, and job placement programs for the community.

stories.title: Elysian Impact to host CatWalk FurBaby runway show
stories.summary: Elysian Impact will return to Sony Hall on September 8 for its fourth annual CatWalk FurBaby event. Produced with Runway 7, the show combines high fashion with animal rescue advocacy. The organization describes the event as a way to elevate compassion as a cultural force during fashion week.

stories.title: Footwear Institute opens admissions for 2027
stories.summary: The Footwear Design and Development Institute has opened admissions for the 2027-28 academic year, offering 240 seats across five programs at its Hyderabad campus. Interested students can apply online until April 20, 2027. An all-India selection test is scheduled to follow in May.
